name: com.sosxr.timelineextensions
description: A collection of scripts that extend the Unity Timeline.

samples.description: Contains some of the samples of this package
Contains Animation Rigging Timeline, since it requires Animation Rigging to work. It will try to install Animation Rigging when you're installing this sample package.
Contains Post Processing Timeline, since it requires Post Processing to work. It will try to install both Post Processing and the Universal Render Pipeline on installation of this sample package.
